summary: Testing Profile Photo and Performance Dashboard feature. All features verified: ProfilePerformanceCard displays on Sales Dashboard and Manager Leads Dashboard with user profile and stats. ProfilePhotoUpload component appears in HR Onboarding Personal Info step. Photo upload/delete/get API endpoints working correctly.
features_tested: ProfilePerformanceCard displays on Sales Dashboard with user photo/initials and stats (Deals Won, Revenue, Conversion, In Progress, Target Achievement)
ProfilePerformanceCard displays on Manager Leads Dashboard with profile and team stats
ProfilePhotoUpload component appears in HR Onboarding Personal Info step with Passport Photo label
Photo upload API endpoint (POST /api/employees/{employee_id}/photo) works with multipart form data
Photo get API endpoint (GET /api/employees/{employee_id}/photo) returns uploaded photo data
Avatar shows initials fallback when no photo uploaded
Photo displays in ProfilePerformanceCard after upload (base64 data URL)
